name: regex_solver1.k
model:
class RegexSolver1 {
  number:String

  req number.matches("[0-9]{3}")

  req number.length = 3
  word:String

  req word.matches("[a-z]+")

  req word.length = 4
  testId:String

  req testId.matches("test[0-9]+")

  req testId.startsWith("test")
  identifier:String

  req identifier.matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*")

  req identifier.length >= 3

  req identifier.length <= 6
}

main:RegexSolver1
